ayahs.en: I swear by this city, Makkah
ayahs.e2: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—

ayahs.en: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city
ayahs.e2: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—

ayahs.en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]
ayahs.e2: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child

ayahs.en: We have certainly created man into hardship
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle

ayahs.ar: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him
ayahs.e2: Do they think that no one has power over them

ayahs.en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance
ayahs.e2: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”

ayahs.en: Does he think that no one has seen him
ayahs.e2: Do they think that no one sees them

ayahs.en: Have We not made for him two eyes
ayahs.e2: Have We not given them two eyes

ayahs.en: And a tongue and two lips
ayahs.e2: a tongue, and two lips

ayahs.en: And have shown him the two ways
ayahs.e2: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺

ayahs.en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass
ayahs.e2: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is

ayahs.en: It is the freeing of a slave
ayahs.e2: It is to free a slave

ayahs.ar: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمࣱ فِي يَوۡمࣲ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
ayahs.e2: or to give food in times of famine
ayahs.tr: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah

ayahs.en: An orphan of near relationship
ayahs.e2: to an orphaned relative

ayahs.en: Or a needy person in misery
ayahs.e2: or to a poor person in distress

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
ayahs.en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion
ayahs.e2: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion
ayahs.tr: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah

ayahs.en: Those are the companions of the right
ayahs.e2: These are the people of the right

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left
ayahs.e2: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah

ayahs.en: Over them will be fire closed in
ayahs.e2: The Fire will be sealed over them
